name: Row
purpose: Background and layout of a list row: the selected band across the task list, the hover wash, the multi-select row and the trash row. Row content comes in as children; the subtask composer and the refine row are their own widgets.

values.when: rounded-field, px-4, gap-5 (multi-select row, trash row).
No radius, edge to edge across the list (x 0 to 860). Task-list selection band.
bg-selection-1 (selection-1 token); the row is selected.
wash-1 token; the row is hovered. Reveals child controls (Open in multi-select rows).
h-9 (multi-select rows; measured at a 32px pitch, which fits 14px rem at 31.5px).

props.name: indent
props.description: Pixels: depth times 24 for task rows.

props.name: children
props.description: Row content. Multi-select rows put the Open button here, shown on hover.

role: none (the parent list owns the role; B's listitem or option proposal is not adopted)
keyboard: None on the surface. Selection is made by the platform modifier: Control-click on Windows, Command-click on macOS (decision). The list owns that, not Row. Row children carry their own keys.
platform: Same. The selection gesture differs by OS modifier, not by look.
open: Merged: A's RowSurface and B's Row are one widget named Row; B's bleed axis is A's shape (contained = inset). B's editing prop belongs to InlineComposer and B's refine-row job to RefineRow, so both are dropped here. Multi-select row density is h-9 in source but 32px measured; pick one px value. Trash row selected tone is uncertain (catalogue shows it on row 2 in trash-selected, per B only). Task list selection colour not measured (light blue in the shot). Last multi row highlight is unverified. The subtask composer's parent row is not in these files.
